'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Phil Johnson DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Phil Johnson]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet title '''R. Smith C.G Deck''' (also read R Search T.G.). Partner Light Side sheet not in Day 2 fax pages 1–32. Line 60 written '''Drag (V)''' — no wiki/GEMP match; published as written (redlink). Line 12 read as [[Staging Areas]] (sheet may say Hoth Staging). Strategic Liaison → [[Strategic Reserves (V)]]; Space Attack → [[Special Delivery (V)]].
